history.overview: Muramite forces established encampments across the Heartlands to maintain control and suppress Dragorn resistance.

timeline.name: Encampment Construction
timeline.description: Muramite soldiers built fortified camps across the plains.

timeline.name: Beast Integration
timeline.description: Warbeasts were introduced into patrol and combat operations.

timeline.name: Discord Bleed
timeline.description: Discord energy corrupted wildlife and destabilized structures.

timeline.name: Resistance Sabotage
timeline.description: Dragorn rebels launched sabotage operations against Muramite supply lines.
